introduction: After 10 years of living in Zagreb, the famous writer Maksim Grahovac returns to his hometown, the Montenegrin village of Grahovo, with the intention of visiting his brother and arranging the inheritance of the property that was left to them. Maksim and Niko have not been in contact for a very long time, and their relationship has become extremely distant and cold over time. On his way to Grahovo, Maksim accidentally kills a man with his car. Frightened and in a state of shock, Maksim throws the man’s body off a cliff and leaves the scene of the accident. Faced with the fact that he cannot solve the problem alone, Maksim confides in Niko and asks him for help to dispose of the body together.
